title: Getting to Know Each Other
description: Ask for and give information about yourself and about other people with the WH-question words (what, how old, how many, how much, where, who, when, why for a cause and why for a purpose): building the question with be, with do/does and with have got, answering it with a full or a quick answer, using because and to, and collecting a classmate's personal details (name, age, height, weight, eye and hair colour, hobbies, town or village, parents' occupations, previous school and English teacher, favourite subject and sport, plans for the school year) in order to introduce him or her to the class and to prepare a project on a famous person
sources: Official programme transcript - .claude/skills/content-ecole-tn/references/programmes-officiels/programme/1ere-sec/anglais.md, lesson 1 "Getting to know each other" (p. 15-17)
